newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt October oilfield production to rise 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Egypt October oilfield production to rise 25 pct.

text.p: Egypt will increase production from its October oilfields to 200,000 barrels per day (bpd) by the end of next year from 160,000 currently, Oil Minister Hamdi el-Banbi said in comments published on Tuesday.
Production from the new East Tanka field alone, one of October's fields, will rise to 20,000 bpd in next December from 3,000, Banbi said at the inauguration of the field on Monday.
"October fields, discovered in 1977... now produce some 20 percent of Egypt's total production," Banbi added.
Egypt produced 835,000 bpd of crude in November.
The minister said production at the October fields, located in the northern part of the Gulf of Suez, would rise due to continued development operations and the discovery of new oil layers.

A $19.5 million water injection project at the October fields was implemented to help increase their extractable reserves, Farouq Tallawi, chairman of Egypt's Gulf of Suez Petroleum/GUPCO, was quoted as saying.
October fields are operated by GUPCO, a joint venture between Amoco and the state's Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation(EGPC).
